name: Factor
summary: FactorVR is a horror game made from inspiration off of OGFMH. Factor has 5+ gamemodes both horror and non horror such as Fast Fredbear, Nextbots, the Facility, or the new Fishing Gamemode where you can fish for power-ups such as flying, or going through the map to avoid monsters that can pop up anywhere to scare away the good dreams from your head!
